stances.summary: Reports food contaminator donated to GOP before Trump delayed food safety tracing rules
stances.quote: Repeat Food Contaminator Gave $2.2 Million to GOP. Now Thousands Are Sick  (by Veronica Riccobene). The suspected source of the cyclospora outbreak, gave $1 million to the MAGA Inc, PAC just days after the Trump administration delayed food tracing rules.
